pharmacological rescue of trafficking-deficient KATP channels can be achieved with sulfonylurease or carbamazepines but not with KATP openers.

pharmacological rescue of SUR1 trafficking defects can be achieved by channel inhibitors, whereas channel openeners are unable to rescue SUR1 trafficking defects.

KATP channels containing trafficking mutations can be rescued by channel inhibitors, which may be useful in the future for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulism.
